articles.title: 4 of family dead: How dispute over hotel lease escalated into mass shooting in Guwahati
articles.summary: A deadly shooting occurred at Hotel Bilas Inn in Guwahati, leaving five people dead and one injured. The accused, Ghanakanta Gogoi, had a dispute over the hotel's lease agreement and opened fire.

Fake seizures, attack on prison guards: How 17 inmates escaped TN jail at midnight
articles.summary: Seventeen undertrial inmates managed to escape from Thekkampatti sub-jail in Tamil Nadu's Theni district. They faked epileptic seizures to lure prison personnel into opening their cell.

articles.title: Son of AAP sarpanch shot dead outside gurdwara in Amritsar
articles.summary: Teerath Singh was shot dead outside a gurdwara in Cheete Kalan village while his friend sustained injuries. Both men were returning from paying respects at the gurdwara when the suspected assailants opened fire.

Ocean Mixing Barrier Shown: Dye experiment maps slow downward transport; layered structure limits exchange
articles.summary: In a recent experiment near Martha’s Vineyard, scientists introduced rhodamine dye into the Atlantic Ocean to study its behavior. The dye spread quickly in the surface waters but demonstrated a slower descent into deeper layers.

Michigan woman buys 128-year-old abandoned church for $45,000 and turns it into her dream home
articles.summary: Whitney Anderson, 45, bought a 128-year-old abandoned church in Michigan for $45,000 and is turning it into her dream home. She has spent an estimated $194,000 on renovations since June 2024 and hopes to complete most of the work by 2028.

articles.title: AIBE XXII registration 2026 closes today: Check fee payment deadline, correction window and exam date and other details here
articles.summary: The Bar Council of India will close the AIBE XXII registration window on October 27, 2026, while the online fee payment deadline is October 28. The application correction facility will be available on October 29 and 30.

articles.title: JK SET answer key 2026 expected soon at jujkset.in: Check download link, question paper and marking scheme
articles.summary: JK SET answer key 2026: The JK SET answer key 2026 is awaited following the examination held on October 25. The University of Kashmir is expected to publish the provisional answer key and question paper PDFs through the official JK SET website.

articles.title: UGC NET December 2026 registration closes tomorrow: Over 5.5 lakh candidates registered, check application status
articles.summary: UGC NET December 2026: UGC NET December 2026 applications close on October 28, with more than 5.5 lakh candidates registered as of October 25. Of these, 3,73,419 have completed their applications and paid the fee.

articles.title: HPSOS exam 2027: Check PCP class dates, attendance rules and study centre fee deadline
articles.summary: HPSOS March 2027 exams: The Himachal Pradesh State Open School (HPSOS) has made Personal Contact Programme (PCP) class attendance mandatory for fresh admission and additional subject candidates appearing in the March 2027 examinations. Classes will run from February 1 to February 18, 2027, and study centres must submit attendance reports by February 19.

articles.title: 'KING' UPDATE: Shah Rukh Khan teases romantic side
articles.summary: In a thrilling announcement, Shah Rukh Khan has shared a brand new poster for his forthcoming film 'KING', set to premiere in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026, just in time for the festive Christmas week. Directed by the talented Siddharth Anand, the film showcases a remarkable cast, including Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone..

articles.title: ‘Jailer 2’: How Rajinikanth and Hrithik’s scene was balanced
articles.summary: Chethan D’Souza revealed his meticulous strategy for crafting action sequences in 'Jailer 2', which stars the iconic Rajinikanth and Mohanlal. He highlighted the critical nature of planning to guarantee the superstars' safety throughout production.

articles.title: Teja Sajja says ‘Zombie Reddy 2’ will feature grander action and visuals
articles.summary: Teja Sajja is currently shooting for 'Zombie Reddy 2 - NXT LVL,' which promises larger action sequences and grand visuals. The film marks the debut of Shanaya Kapoor in South Indian cinema and features veteran Upendra in a key role.

articles.title: Online reaction to Rashmika Mandanna’s post about her and Vijay Deverakonda’s relationship
articles.summary: In response to the criticism about her relationship with Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna expressed her gratitude for supportive fans. She explained misunderstood comments from an interview, confirming their year-long dialogue about commitment, which didn't require an extravagant proposal.
